title: Page 280
text: * Bob-stones is a traditional game of rabbits. It is played with small stones, fragments of stick or the like. Fundamentally it is a very simple kind of gambling, on the lines of ‘Odds or Evens’. A ‘cast’ of stones on the ground is covered by the player’s front paw. The opponent must then hazard some sort of surmise about its nature, e.g. one or two, light or dark, rough or smooth.
